title: Purely Optimized
description: The definitive, performance-first modpack. No bloat, just pure frames.
body: ![purelyoptimizedbanner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/caba09d94fd08ba1bf2a78fe3bb923eee55f70ce.png) --- **Purely Optimized** *isn't just another Simply Optimized clone,* it's a clean collection of the most effective optimization mods, pre-configured for maximum hardware utilization. The definitive, performance-first modpack. No bloat, just pure frames. Pure Performance: No visual mods. No gameplay tweaks. This is a raw performance base. User Control: **You are expected to add any non-optimization mods yourself.** Fast Updates: The lean structure allows for updates to new Minecraft versions within minutes of a stable mod release. Strictly optimization. Nothing else. --- ***Built on Sodium & Lithium by CaffeineMC***
